notes.title: Private autosaved blog drafts and version history
notes.summary: The visual writer autosaves private working drafts, including revisions to already-published articles. Live content and metadata change only through explicit publication. Private history keeps the latest 100 checkpoints, every five minutes and on manual saves, publishing and restores, with preview and restore-to-draft controls.

notes.title: Safer draft recovery and scheduled revisions
notes.summary: Serialized saves, version tokens and retry receipts protect drafts against uncertain saves and competing tabs. Approved scheduled updates leave the current article live until due; later draft edits and history restores do not change that approved revision. Admin backups include private draft history and schedules, while static SEO snapshots, RSS and sitemap still refresh on deployment.
